Each lane runs in its own git worktree at C:/git/ht-lanes/lane-<x> (outside the repo, so jest in the main checkout never sees the copies), with its own npm ci --legacy-peer-deps.

Agents must not use git stash: the stash stack is shared across worktrees and holds 2 pre-sprint human stashes. A pre-fix proof checks out the pre-fix source files by sha and restores them afterwards.
Work orders are saved verbatim at C:/git/ht-lanes/wo/<issue>.md (outside the repo) so a resumed session can re-dispatch without re-analysing.
Tester and security run in parallel on the same commit range where security applies. An issue is ready only when both approve; a REJECT and a BLOCK in the same round count as one round trip.
State is committed on sprint/auto-fixes after every transition. The branch is pushed at lane-level events, not per state commit, because every push starts a CI run.
